content: Jesu yo Balisa Omubika no Mukulu no Masole no Muloma
Cwale Jesu aba ana kumana okwambela aanu sebeli oingena mu Kapenauma.
Cwale omukulu no masole kame ana kwikalanga ni mubika waye ona ku singiwangwa onene, ona ku tomanga mi kame ana kwikala abeebi ni kufa.
Cwale aba ana kuyupa eya Jesu, sebeli omutumena akulu no Majuda oka mukumbela nji aiye mu kubalisa omubika waye.
Mi cwale awo aba ana kwiiya kwa Jesu, sebeli amu kumbela onene mu likute aamba nji, “Kame ku fanena nji wene omutendele eyi ngeeso.
Kakuli kame asinga aanu etu, mane na tuyakele endoo no milapelo.”

Cwale Jesu sebeli ota noo. Abana ka keela ku nyonga no ndoo, omukulu no masole sebeli omutumena alikani, sebeli aiya mukwamba kwa yonyene nji, “Mbumu olese oku kataza kakuli silukele nji wene wingene munji no lituwa no ndoo yange,
bokame nina ku mona nji simba oukumonahaza kwa wene sifanene. Kono waambe eliywi mi omubika wange mba bala.

Kakuli mene naba nili munji no maata no akwange, kame nili ni masole ange, mi aba naamba ku munjili nji, ‘Ote!’ kame ata, ni ku munjili nji, ‘Wiiye!’ kame aiya, ni ku mubika wange aba naamba nji, ‘Otende esi!’ mi kame asi tenda.”
Cwale Jesu aba ana kuyupa eyi sebeli okomoka, niku siulukela kwaanu ana ku mukon̄a ni kwaambela nji, “Kame ni myambela, simba mu Isilaele kani siwana etumelo iku fekile kanyi eyi!”
Mi cwale awo ana ku tumiwa aba ana kuukela ku ndoo, sebeli aka wana omubika yooli wino.
Jesu yo Ingula Omwana no Mbakati
Munyima nweyo, Jesu sebeli ota mu mulenen̄i wisanwa Naine, na iyetwa aye ni undi no aanu sebeli ata naye.
Ababo yo keela feela ba mwelo no mulenen̄i, sebeli okwangana naanu ashimbile omufu, neli mwana mumweya no ndumbana kwa inawaye mi neli mbakati, naanu no kupula ana ku tunda mu mulenen̄i aenda naye.
Cwale Ombumu aba ana kumona omukati woyo, sebeli omuyupela amakeke ni ku mwambela nji, “Olese ku lila”
Cwale sebeli wiiya ni ku lema ba lukutu, mi awo ana ku lushimba sebeli aimana. Cwale sebeli wamba nji, “Ndumbana, kame naamba kwa wene nji, inguka!”
Cwale omunu ona kufa sebeli oimana ni kutangisa okwamba, mi Jesu sebeli omuusa kwa inawaye.
Cwale onje sebeli aingenwa okucila, ni kuyeema Nyambe aamba nji, “Omunuhi munene wa Nyambe na monahala mukaci ketu!” mi “Nyambe na potele aanu aye!”
Cwale elibubo lyaye sebeli lihasana mu naha yonje no Judeya ni mu tinaha tonje tiku bapile nayo.
Elin̄usa Okutunda kwa Jowani Omukolobezi
Aiyetwa a Jowani sebeli amwambela einu yonje.
Cwale Jowani sebeli oisana aiyetwa aye ayiili, ni kwatuma kwa Mbumu nji akaibangute nji, “Kana yawene woyo fanene okwiiya, nji tu tatelele omunjili?”
Cwale alume awo aba ana kukeela kwa Jesu, sebeli aamba nji, “Jowani Omukolobezi natu tumu kwa wene mukwibanguta nji yawene onafanene okwiiya, nji tutalele omunjili?’”
Mu nako eyo Jesu na kubalisa aanu no kupula ku meeti oo ni iyanga ni mebo no kwiiba, ni ibofu no kupula sebeli oimonisa.

Cwale Jesu sebeli waatambula nji, “Mute mi mukambele Jowani eyi muna mono neyi muna yupu, eibofu kame imona, eiyanga kame yeenda, asi mbingwa kame akenisiwa, aafu kame aingulwa, mi aa ashebile kame aambelwa eliywi no kuwaba.
Cwale embuyoti niya woyo oulwa oku sitatala kwa mene!”

Cwale awo ana kutumiwa kwa Jowani aba ana kuuka, Jesu sebeli otangisa okwamba eyi ya Jowani kwaanu no kupula nji, “Iikene muno kamona aba muna kuta mu lihaupa, neli olutaka luna ku nyanganyisiwa ku mebo?
Iikene cwale muna kutela oka mona? Nji neli omunu ona kukufuka eikumango no kotoba? Komumone, awo aku fukile eyi no kubenya ni ku yoya wino kame ali mu tindoo no Ambumu!
Cwale iikene muna kutela oka mona? Neli omunuhi wa Nyambe? Ee, kame nimyambela nji, mane okubitelela omunuhi wa Nyambe.
Eyi yokame eyaye in̄olilwe nji, ‘Komumone, kame nituma onumwana wange ba lubala no lubala lowe yokame solukisa endila yowe balubala lowe.’
Kame ni myambela nji, “Kwaaawo ana leiwa kwaakati kakwisa woyo no kuneneba kwa Jowani, kono woyo no kucaniba mu mubuso wa Nyambe yo munene okubita Jowani.”
Aanu onje aba ana kumuyupa na telisi sebeli ayeema Nyambe ni ku kolobeziwa mu kolobezo ya Jowani omukolobezi.
Kono Afalisi na iyeti no mulawo sebeli akana omulelo wa Nyambe mu kukolobeziwa mu kolobezo ya Jowani.
Cwale aanu no lusika olu kame sana fanikete ni siikene? Mi iikene aku fekile nayo?
Kame aku fekile kanyi anukana awo aikalile mu sibaka no musika akwisana omunjili ku munjili nji, ‘Natu mipetele, kono kamwa sinenga! Natu miimbele etindimo no malilo kono kamwa silila!
Kakuli Jowani nakwiiya yo kali esinkwa ni kunwa ewaine, mi kame mwamba nji, ‘Kame akwete emebo no kwiiba!’
Omwana no Munu kame aneeyi yoolya ni kunwa, mi kame mwamba nji, ‘Komumone, kame alya ni kunwa, omulikani no atelisi na sikutenda eibi!’
Kono oku shangama na kukenisetwe anaye onje.”
Jesu yoli ku Ndoo ya Simoni Omufalisi
Omujili no Afalisi sebeli okumbela Jesu nji akalye naye, mane sebeli ota mu ndoo no mufalisi nukekala ba tafule.
Mi omukati na mu mulenen̄i, osi kutenda eibi aba ana kuyupa nji Jesu kame ali mu ndoo no Mufalisi, sebeli olita esitewelo no maati siisaniwa alabasita
ni kwimana ku nyonga ya Jesu ku makondo aye, sebeli olila ni kombisa amakondo a Jesu ni myooti yaye. Cwale sebeli otundisa emyooti ni tin̄uki na ku mutwi waye, ni kwatubeta, okwawaa ni maati.

Cwale Omufalisi woyo ona ku mwisana aba ana ku mona eyo, sebeli okwambisa yomboci nji, “Kambe wuyu mulume munuhi wa Nyambe luli, kambe kame amulikile wuyu mukati omulema ni ku limuka eyi atenda nji osiku tenda eibi!”
Cwale Jesu sebeli otambula ni kwamba kwa yonyene nji, “Simoni, kwasili eso ni singa okwamba kwa wene.” Mi sebeli otambula nji, “Iikene eyo, Mwiyeti?”
Omunu munjili kame ana ku kolotisa alume ayiili amali, omunjili sebeli omukolotisa amali no ku kwana ba myaanda itanu, mi omunjili kame sebeli omuba makumi atanu.
Cwale aba ana ku kwangwa oku teneka sebeli walemena onje. Cwale kwaawo ayiili anyine somu singa onene?”
Simoni sebeli otambula nji, “Kame ni kakanya nji woyo ona lemeniwa onene.” Cwale Jesu sebeli omwambela nji, “Nu atula wino.”

Cwale Jesu sebeli ofutukela ku mukati ni kwamba kwa Simoni nji, “Omwine wuyu mukati, ine ingene mu ndoo yowe, kausiniba ameyi no ukuyowa ku makondo ange, kono wuyu mukati na ombisa amakondo ange ni myooti yaye ni kwitundisa ni tin̄uki taye.
Kawasi nitubeta, kono oku tunda ba nako ina ingene muno, kasi lesela oku tubeta amakondo ange.
Kausi waa omutwi wange ni maati, kono yonyene na waa amaati ku makondo ange.
Cwalehe kame ni kwambela nji, eibi yaye eyo itendile nji yakupula, nai lemenwe kakuli kame anisinga onene, kono woyo olemeniwa mbicani kame asinga mbicani.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wambela omukati nji, “Eibi yowe nwilemenwe.”
Cwale awo ana kwikala naye ku tafule sebeli atangisa okwambisa mu micima yoo nji, “Anyine wuyu, wuyu otwesa simba oku lemena eibi?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba ku mukati nji, “Etumelo yowe naiku yoyisa, weende mu kozo.”
